question: In which city is the headquarters of the Squash Rackets Federation of India (SRFI) situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Squash Rackets Federation of India (SRFI)** is the governing body for squash in India, overseeing the development and promotion of the sport across the nation.
 
• The headquarters of the **SRFI is situated in Chennai**, Tamil Nadu.
 
• Chennai has emerged as a central hub for squash activities due to its infrastructural facilities, including world-class squash courts and training centers.
 
• The SRFI works closely with the **Asian Squash Federation (ASF)** and the **World Squash Federation (WSF)** to organize tournaments and enhance India's presence in international squash competitions.
 
• It organizes various national tournaments, coaching programs, and youth development initiatives to improve squash standards in India.
 
• Chennai is also home to several squash academies and has hosted major national and international squash tournaments, making it a logical choice for SRFI'
